faqs.q: Is the Free plan really forever?
faqs.a: Yes. Free Forever is not a trial — it never expires. You keep it as long as you want.

faqs.q: Is there a free trial on paid plans?
faqs.a: Growth has a 14-day free trial with full feature access in every market. No credit card required.
Yes — a 14-day money-back window on annual plans (7-day on monthly renewals), pro-rated on India annual plans. See the refund policy at /legal/refunds.
Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time.
No setup fees and no hidden costs on any plan.

Free Forever, Growth, and Enterprise — the same ladder in every market. Growth is the hero plan at $10/user/mo annually ($12 monthly in the US); Enterprise is custom-priced. Managed RevOps is a separate flat-fee service, available as an add-on on Growth and included with Enterprise.
Yes — 50% off Growth for nonprofits with documentation.

Varies by market — US: credit card, ACH, PayPal, Stripe. India: UPI, Razorpay, Net Banking, credit/debit card. UK: card, Stripe, GoCardless, bank transfer. India prices are exclusive of GST — 18% GST is added on top (₹899 bills as ₹1,060.82). Call pricing_get_country_plans for a specific market.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum number of users?
faqs.a: No minimum. The Free plan supports 1 user (150 leads). Growth and Enterprise scale from 1 user upward. The Managed RevOps tiers (Growth Engine, RevOps Partner) are flat monthly retainers with no per-seat charge.

faqs.q: Does the Managed RevOps service require a long-term contract?
faqs.a: No long-term contract required, but a 3-month initial engagement is recommended.
Annual plans are 10 months paid, 2 months free — effectively a 17% discount. Billed upfront annually.
